maddeler.e:
تلتووا (form VIII)
# تَلْتَوُوا (taltawū) /tal.ta.wuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَوَى (iltawā)
# تُلْتَوَوْا (tultawaw) /tul.ta.waw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَوَى (iltawā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
